description:
Deep-copy a node with optional property overrides.

Examples:
```text
clone_node({node: "1:2"})                                 — clone to page root, same name
clone_node({node: "1:2", parent: "/"})                    — clone to page root explicitly
clone_node({node: "1:2", parent: "/", name: "Hero Copy"}) — clone to root with custom name
clone_node({node: "1:2", parent: "1:4"})                  — clone into parent node 1:4
clone_node({node: "1:2", parent: "1:4", overrides: {"bg": "#D9D9D9"}})
```

overrides.description: Property overrides applied to the clone — same registry key-space as edit.props (w/h/corner/opacity/rotate/blur/shadow/visible, any registry prop, or "Child.prop" to override a named descendant). Use the top-level `name` to rename. Pass real keys, never {}.

clipsContent.description: Clip children overflowing the frame; false | true; default true

shadow.description: Drop shadow shorthand "0 2 8 #00000040", or raw Effect[]

parent.description: Target parent node ID or "/" for page root

name: clone_node
